mask: Natural Earth land and lake rings of the map's own us_east geodata (even-odd, holes are lakes), cell-centre rule

classes.coast_band: one transparent cell on each side of every coast and lake shore
classes.no_lake_bathymetry: lake shading is a shore band from the lake rings only
